assign.outcome:
**Drag a real page in Make and its directory moves on disk.** Open Make with `?real=<url>` and the left pane grows a third group: that url's real pages — ordinary directories with a `page.js` each. Drag one onto another, and the right pane asks in a full sentence ("Move `/a/b/` into `/c/` — the folder moves on disk"). Press Move and three things happen: `rpc:move` renames the directory with one atomic `fs.rename`, the two `page.js` files that name it get their `children:` lines rewritten, and Undo is offered for one minute.

![](confirm.png)

**Proved end to end** on a scratch tree of three real pages, driven headless. Before: `alpha`, `alpha/gamma`, `beta` — root `children: "alpha beta"`, alpha `children: "gamma"`. After dragging Beta onto Alpha: `alpha`, `alpha/beta`, `alpha/gamma` — root `children: "alpha"`, alpha `children: "gamma beta"`. Three directories before, three after. `/…/alpha/beta/` answers with the title "Beta"; `/…/beta/` is a 404. A cold reload of Make shows the new tree. Undo put all four facts back exactly. With alpha declaring `children: ["gamma"]` instead, Move answers "`alpha/page.js` declares its children as `children: ["gamma"],` — this can only rewrite a plain string, so nothing was moved" and the disk is untouched.

**Needs the owner: restart the dev server.** `rpc:move` is a `Server/` change, so it is live only after a restart (1 minute). Until then the confirm row appears and Move answers nothing.

**What landed** — `Server/plugins/SocketServer/Runtime.js` (`rpc:move`, beside `rpc:rm`, behind the same loopback-only socket) · `public/imagine/paging/make/real.js` (new: the `?real=` group, the confirm row, the move, the `children:` rewriter) · `tree.js`, `page.js`, `make.css` (wiring, two new classes) · [`readme.md`](/imagine/paging/make/readme.md) · [`doc/decisions.md`](/imagine/paging/make/doc/decisions.md) · [`Server/README.md`](/Server/README.md).

**Two `ux/Tree` defects found and guarded here**, because that module was outside the fence — both in `doc/decisions.md §5`, with the one-line fix for each. A drop is followed by a `click` on the row, so `onSelect` fires after `onMove` and cleared the confirm question. And an unopened branch counts as zero children, so a drop into a folded page landed first among them instead of last.

**Left, on purpose** — Make still cannot EDIT a real page, only move it (a `page.js` is code, not data). The `children` shape this rewrites is a plain string or nothing; the alternative that needs no rewriting at all — a `children()` function reading a `tree.json` — is written up in `doc/decisions.md §4` with when it wins. Core's `declare("")` declares a child with no name (`.filter(Boolean)` is the one-line fix); core was out of fence, so this side removes an empty `children:` line instead. The scratch tree `/imagine/paging/made-real/` was deleted at landing, as briefed.
